data.narrative: On April 10, 2026, a critical internal control failure was detected during system monitoring. The Report phase of the fraud detection workflow attempted to emit sensitive customer data—including SSN, DOB, and KYC status—from memory store FM2 (customer_profiles), which is restricted to higher-privilege phases. The data pertained to multiple customers, including ACC-70921 under enhanced review with linked external settlement account acct-ext-4483, and ACC-10088-S, a synthetic identity under investigation. Access to FM2 was improperly granted during report generation, indicating a potential configuration flaw or insider threat. No external exfiltration has been confirmed, but the incident constitutes a reportable internal data breach under FinCEN guidelines. Alert ALERT-SEC-2026-0410-001 was created and escalated to the BSA Officer. No customer funds were compromised, but data confidentiality was breached. Investigation into root cause and access logs is ongoing.
